sources.ownParaphrase: RSC uses salicylic acid, ethanoic anhydride and phosphoric acid in a supervised microscale synthesis; its published quantities and bath conditions agree with the supplied base design. The added cooling/quench, mass ledger and tests remain explicitly reviewed author adaptations.

RSC compares an iron(III) colour response for free salicylic acid against standards. Its solvent, iron concentration and stock dilution support the base assay. The new equal-volume matrix controls and own synthesis powder replace the tablet format and are assessed as bounded adaptations.

The RSC student sheet supplies the aspirin reference melting interval and interprets broadening/depression as a purity clue. The reviewed design correctly adds pure/mixed references and does not equate a narrow interval with exhaustive purity.

safetyBoundary: Source crosscheck supports a supervised school design, not permission to perform locally without the stated current risk assessment.
